provenance.generator: shared/generated-navigation.ts identifies scripts/evolution/generate.ts and model/evolution/state.json; all three bound to exact baseline bytes
provenance.nodeOrder: full graph generated by original z outer/x inner loops and original neighborPairs ordering; selected original IDs sorted ascending; retained adjacency preserves original link order

graph.extraction: BFS from real navigation node nearest (0,20), first64 discovered, then original-index order; all induced edges retained

verification.independentReference: Bellman-Ford unit-edge relaxation and all route-edge witnesses

workload.kind: seeded synthetic source/target selections on real collision-checked subgraph; not a recorded gameplay trace

cold.note: manual first compile precedes wrapper first call; wrapper compiles same bytes again and V8 may cache compilation; dynamic import includes tsx module loading

limits: Node/shared virtual environment, not browser or physical-hardware game benchmark
64-node induced subgraph omits outside routes; distances are for that subgraph only
Uniform node-pair selection not actual bot goals
20 rotated-order trials with four warmups; no formal confidence intervals
No source copy or production edits; exact upstream binary assembled only in scratch memory
